assay_run.method: Study-level aggregate of the 5-day vehicle-versus-etoposide comparison, across three biological replicates. Quasar 570 probes targeting the middle region of NEAT1_2, followed by anti-NONO immunofluorescence. NONO and NEAT1_2 were imaged at 488 and 561 nm, respectively, in the same single z-plane; paraspeckles were defined as double-positive foci.
assay_run.platform: ZEISS LSM710 confocal microscope; 100x/1.4 oil objective
